Hello Leo,

We have granted you the following access groups from Priya Nair's access, which you do not already have:
- SYN-GRP-CONFLUENCE-FINANCE (Confluence finance space)
- SYN-GRP-FINREP-READ (Finance Reports readers)
- SYN-GRP-JIRA-WRITE (Jira editors)

Access to the following groups requires manager approval and is currently pending for operator review:
- SYN-GRP-FINREP-WRITE (Finance Reports editors)
- SYN-GRP-PAYROLL-ADMIN (Payroll administrators)

We will update you once these approvals are processed.

Regards,
IT Access Desk
